title: Luscious French Chicken Casserole
description: A hearty, spicy, Jain-friendly French dish featuring chicken cooked in red wine and topped with a creamy fromage-blanc and crispy ssam-wrap. Excellent for a sick day or a cozy night in.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, and nutmeg. In a large Dutch oven, sauté the chicken in butter until browned, then set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually add the red wine and chicken broth, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook until the sauce thickens, about 10 minutes.
Add the chicken back to the pot and simmer until the chicken is cooked through, about 10-15 minutes.
Transfer the chicken to a baking dish and top with the fromage-blanc. Bake until the fromage-blanc is golden brown and bubbly, about 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a pan with a small amount of oil over medium-high heat. Add the ssam-wrap squares and cook until crispy and golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Once the chicken is done, top it with the crispy ssam-wrap and sprinkle with chopped thyme. Serve hot and enjoy!
